The Chief Ministers of the concerned States are required to submit annual reports to the Union Home Ministry on the administration of Scheduled Areas in the States. questions.language_status: English structured extraction; Telugu not included in index
questions.explanation_en: Statement 1 is correct — Scheduled Areas are notified by the President. Statement 2 is incorrect — the specification is based on contiguous area, not strictly district/village cluster. Statement 3 is incorrect — reports go to Ministry of Tribal Affairs, not Home Ministry. Only one statement is correct.
